title: UCB Data100: Principles and Techniques of Data Science

unit.title: Reproducible Data Cleaning and Audit Contracts
unit.scope: A self-contained software-engineering kickoff using a small tabular-data audit; it is not a reconstruction of an official Data100 assignment.
prerequisites: Comfort writing Python functions and command-line programs
Familiarity with tabular data and asymptotic analysis
learning_objectives: Turn ambiguous data-cleaning expectations into explicit, testable contracts
Distinguish missing values from invalid values without silently losing rows
Separate parsing, normalization, validation, aggregation, and I/O
Test both ordinary behavior and failure behavior

required_evidence: All required learner deliverables are present in the attempt workspace
The generated audit artifact conforms to the published unit contract
The learner's design note and comprehension responses are independently evaluated
completion_policy.course_completion_statement: Completing this kickoff can complete only the prepared local unit. It does not complete, certify, or substitute for the approximately 80-hour Data100 course.
completion_policy.promotion_rule: Only a validator controlled by the worker harness may promote the unit from PREPARED_UNVALIDATED to a successful terminal state.

validation.label: UNVALIDATED_PREPARATION
validation.meaning: Files are prepared for independent harness validation; their presence is not completion evidence.
